# The Judges
[textlink="Caelestinus Central" link="Caelestinus"] answers to no navy. When the TSF and the USSP fell out over the sector, the station's company hired its own guns: the [color=#d4c38a]judges[/color].
Judges are elite security contractors, paid well and trained better. Two judge ships fly a standing patrol around the station, one on each side, and a lost ship is replaced within the hour.
## Their law
- Keep the approaches clear of Reavers, the ADS, corsairs and rogue drones. - Leave captains alone. A judge does not ask where your cargo came from. - Answer heavy fire with heavier fire.
Traders sleep easier for it. The judges are a large part of why Caelestinus Central is still the one safe harbour in the sector.
